content_preview.title: Scribe Therapeutics Files for Nasdaq IPO, Testing Investor Appetite for Early-Stage CRISPR Gene-Editing Biotechs
content_preview.summary: The Jennifer Doudna-founded CRISPR biotech filed to go public under ticker SCTX as its lead cholesterol therapy remains early in human testing.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Scribe Therapeutics, the CRISPR gene-editing biotechnology company co-founded by Nobel Prize laureate Jennifer Doudna, filed a prospectus with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on July 2 to pursue an initial public offering, according to [BioSpace](https://www.biospace.com/business/early-stage-scribe-wants-to-write-ipo-story-even-as-investors-favor-derisked-portfolios). The California-based company intends to list on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker symbol "SCTX,"...

editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Checked every specific in the article against the two snapshots. Confirmed verbatim/accurate: SEC prospectus filed July 2 (BioSpace: 'prospectus filed July 2'); Nasdaq Global Market ticker 'SCTX' (both sources); Scribe launched 2020, CEO Benjamin Oakes ex-Doudna researcher (BioPharma Dive); BioSpace's exact phrase 'the Jennifer Doudna-founded biotech' reproduced verbatim in quotes; $120M raised from Andreessen Horowitz/Avoro Ventures/OrbiMed and $25M+ CIRM grant (BioPharma Dive); Sanofi $25M upfront + $40M 2023 expansion (BioPharma Dive); Lilly/Prevail deal worth up to $1.5B with two milestones hit (BioPharma Dive); Biogen ALS collaboration announced shortly after 2020 launch (BioPharma Dive); STX-1150 mechanism, PCSK9 target, single-dose vs. Repatha/Praluent comparison, entered clinic in June (BioPharma Dive); BioSpace's exact phrases 'recently entered a first-in-human study in Australia' and 'according to the biotech's prospectus' reproduced verbatim in quotes; STX-1200 (Lp(a)) and STX-1400 (triglycerides) preclinical programs (BioSpace); '14th venture-backed biotech to price an IPO in 2026' (BioPharma Dive); Kardigan $400M June raise (both sources agree); Metagenomi ~$94M 2024 IPO as last gene-editing IPO (BioPharma Dive); Parabilis $670M June raise and Kailera $625M April raise (BioSpace); Ben Zercher/PitchBook quote reproduced verbatim and correctly attributed to BioSpace (BioSpace). One nuance scrutinized: the article states the Lilly/Prevail milestones 'generated two milestone payments' where BioPharma Dive's more hedged phrasing is 'hit two milestone achievements, making Scribe eligible for two unspecified payments' -- in standard biotech deal structure, hitting a milestone is what triggers/generates the associated payment, so this is a reasonable paraphrase rather than a fabrication or overstatement; it does not affect the headline, summary, or lead and is not flagged as a correction. The internal link to the May 26, 2026 TGA-clearance article was verified against that article's own content (TGA clearance, STX-1150, PCSK9) and is accurate. No fabricated quotes, no hallucinated statistics, no orphan source URLs (all external links in body_markdown map to the two declared sources; the one internal /article/ link is not a claim needing external sourcing).
